target: length-31 total-zero sequence with no nonempty zero-sum subsequence of length <=5
context: Such a sequence is necessary for D_4(C_5^3)=31 under the X1-K total-zero extremal reduction. Proving none exists proves 31 in C_0(C_5^3), hence D_4(C_5^3)=30 because 30<=D_4<=31.

symbolic_reductions.multiplicity_cap: every support-point multiplicity is at most 4
symbolic_reductions.support_8: the only pattern is 4^7 3; restoring the missing fourth copy preserves short-freeness, so Property C applies. The support-level dual check enumerates 564 normalized admissible supports and finds zero satisfying the total-zero deletion condition -sigma(U) in U.
symbolic_reductions.support_ge_9_saturated: if a length-31 short-free sequence of support >8 were extendable by one nonzero point while remaining short-free, the resulting length-32 sequence would be Property-C and have support 8; contradiction. Hence every support>8 candidate is Sigma_{<=4}-saturated.
symbolic_reductions.no_multiplicity_3: saturation at a multiplicity-3 point x would require a <=4 representation of -x; avoiding a pre-existing <=5 zero-sum forces all three copies of x into that representation, leaving at most one term which would have to equal x, impossible.
symbolic_reductions.pattern_equations: for support s>=9 write a=#mult1,b=#mult2,c=#mult4. Then a+b+c=s and a+2b+4c=31, equivalently b+3c=31-s and a=2s-31+2c.
symbolic_reductions.multiplicity_4_projective_isolation: a multiplicity-4 point cannot share its projective line with another support point
symbolic_reductions.four_mult4_span_rank3: four multiplicity-4 points cannot lie in rank <=2 because their 16 terms exceed eta(C_5^2)=13
symbolic_reductions.mixed_basis_rule: whenever a high-multiplicity seed together with the multiplicity-2 stratum would exceed eta(C_5^2)=13 if rank<=2, the seed-plus-mult2 stratum must span rank3; this authorizes normalizations such as (2,2,2), (4,2,2), and (4,4,2) on e1,e2,e3.
symbolic_reductions.rank2_c4_3_outside2: if the three multiplicity-4 points span a plane and the multiplicity-2 stratum would make >13 terms in that plane, at least one multiplicity-2 point lies outside; the plane stabilizer normalizes that point to e3.
